stdout: All three call sites to `InventoryService::save` are now covered — `src/main.cpp` (both `inv.save` calls, plus the `<iostream>` include) and `src/service/order_service.cpp` (the `inventory_.save` call inside `OrderService::save`). `orders.save(p1)` in main.cpp calls `OrderService::save`, not `InventoryService::save` directly, so it's correctly left alone — its internal delegation is already covered in order_service.cpp.
